blocks.text: How to manage tab sprawl in Chrome on Mac

Tab sprawl is the enemy of a recruiter. When you have twenty tabs open for three different roles, your focus breaks. Create a separate Chrome profile for each active requisition. Go to the Profile icon at the top right, select Add, and name it after the role. This keeps your cookies, history, and extensions isolated. You can even use different colors for each profile to stay organized.

items: ⌘ + T: Open a new tab instantly.
⌘ + L: Jump to the address bar to search for a candidate name.
⌘ + 1 through ⌘ + 8: Switch to a specific tab in your current window.
⌘ + W: Close your current tab when you finish a screening call.
⌘ + ⇧ + T: Reopen the last tab you closed by accident.

blocks.text: You do not need to manually copy and paste candidate data. When you need a summary of a candidate profile or a company, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur to research it. Lazur opens its own background tabs, gathers the info, and gives you a clean report. This keeps your main Chrome window clear of clutter.

Writing interview scorecards takes forever. Hold the fn key in your ATS text box and dictate your notes. Lazur cleans up the text, fixes the grammar, and formats it for you. You save minutes on every candidate. This adds up to hours every week.
Quick tips for Chrome power users

items: Pin your ATS and email tabs: Right-click a tab and select Pin. It stays at the left edge of your bar.
Clear cache for one site: If a site bugs out, use the site settings menu to clear only that site's data.
Use search engines: In Chrome settings, you can add shortcuts for LinkedIn or your ATS to search them directly from the address bar.
Block notifications: Stop interruptions by blocking site notifications in Settings > Privacy and security > Site settings.

blocks.text: How to handle repetitive admin tasks

Recruiters spend over half their time on manual work. Use Lazur to guide you through complex settings in Chrome. If you forget where a setting is, just ask. Lazur will circle it for you on the screen. This saves you from hunting through deep menus when you are already busy with a candidate call.

Recruiting data is sensitive. Lazur only sees your screen when you hold the shortcut key. It does not store your screenshots or audio. You can work with confidence knowing your candidate data stays on your Mac. This is vital when you are handling personal information all day.

Start by setting up your profiles for your current open roles. Then, try using the dictation feature for your next set of interview notes. When you get stuck or need to find a setting, ask Lazur to point it out. You will notice the difference in your daily flow immediately.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside my ATS?
faq.answer: Lazur works with any app on your Mac. You can dictate into your ATS or ask Lazur to point at buttons on the screen.

faq.question: Can Lazur fill out job application forms for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or type into forms on your behalf. It helps you by dictating text and pointing at items.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe for candidate data?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only looks at your screen when you press the shortcut. It does not store your screen data or audio.

faq.question: How do I speed up my browser on Mac?
faq.answer: Use separate Chrome profiles, remove unused extensions, and clear your cache regularly for sites that slow down.
